lines.rom: arati sri ramayana ji ki kirati kalita lalita siya pi ki
gavata brahmadika muni narada valmiki vigyana visarada suka sanakadi sesa aru sarada barani pavanasuta kirati niki
gavata samtata sambhu bhavani aru ghatasambhava muni bigyani vyasa adi kabibarja bakhani kagabhusumdi garura ke hi ki
